nodes.name: On workflow error
nodes.notes: Fires when the recipe workflow throws an unhandled error.

nodes.name: Log the failure
nodes.notes: Writes one readable line to the n8n log and hands the single fields to the mail node.

parameters.subject: ={{ "[Code a Cuisine] " + $json.workflow + " failed: " + $json.error }}
parameters.text:
={{ "A workflow of Code a Cuisine stopped with an unhandled error.

"
  + "Workflow:     " + $json.workflow + "
"
  + "Failed node:  " + $json.node + "
"
  + "Error:        " + $json.error + "
"
  + "Execution:    " + $json.executionId + " (" + $json.mode + ")
"
  + "Time (UTC):   " + $json.failedAt + "
"
  + "Open in n8n:  " + $json.executionUrl + "

"
  + "Stack trace:
" + ($json.stack || "not reported") }}

nodes.name: Email the failure
nodes.notes: Sends the failure to the maintainer. The SMTP credential is filled in by hand in the n8n UI; no access data lives in the repo. The log line above stays as the fallback when the mail server is unreachable.
